posts.what: A close side view at dusk of the drum motor's copper commutator, with one brush above and one below and a small blue-violet glow where the lower brush breaks contact; the motor runs on its own and nothing else on the island changes.
posts.recipe: simulated device left alone, close fixed camera on its sparking commutator at dusk
posts.shared: same drum motor at dusk, close camera, sparks at the commutator; only the spark colour and size are new

posts.what: A dusk view of the same drum motor on its oak block, now lit by a small clay oil lamp, showing the copper windings, the brushes and the cords up from the six pots; the motor turns and nothing else changes except that a lamp now stands there.
posts.recipe: simulated device left alone, close camera, a new small prop lighting it
posts.shared: same motor at dusk filmed close while it runs alone; the lamp is the only new thing, and the rope it promises is not shown

forms.form: Physics study of simulated objects moving alone, filmed
New crafted prop shown still, nothing happens
